hypothesis: Growing K from 4 to 8 or 16 while keeping 289 learned coefficients improves structured heldout quality and the nonlinear Householder-tanh-inverse weight decoder beats matched direct affine addressing.

teacher.address8_aligned: fixed 8-page Mirror teacher same program family but independently sampled core+gates+codes; student not shown teacher theta

comparability.address_basis: fixed seeded signed permutations; first four pages identical across 4/8/16
comparability.bank_offsets: extra bank pages deterministic, generated from a separate seed stream; two-code angular logits at K>4
comparability.decoder_equivalence: Mirror/affine have identical routing/pages but different decoder as MA-1168
comparability.matched_bytes: packet 20B header + 289 float32; count inference program and transient bank separately

thresholds.page_quality: At least one K in [8,16] gains >=5% fresh NMSE over K4 of same decoder on >=5/6 pairs and median ratio <=0.95; disclose OOD/runtime even if passes
thresholds.mirror_specific: For at least one K, Mirror beats same-K affine by >=5% fresh NMSE on >=5/6 pairs and median ratio <=0.95; no unqualified win if compute higher
thresholds.adoption: Mirror-specific quality pass AND <=matched-affine measured median inference latency at batch1+64 AND < native289 fresh NMSE median and <= native289 payload bytes; otherwise no adoption
thresholds.mechanism: gradients of physical core, gates, addresses nonzero; all weights finite and shape[75,110]; first-four maps exact; tested packet roundtrip

statistical_scope: n=6 paired worlds/seeds is exploratory, not population significance; fresh not used for tuning; fixed updates not convergence
fresh_policy: Evaluate once after all frozen model optimization, never retune.
